Configure PaddleOCR language, model tier, and model version

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}", "{\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"paddleocr\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"en\"],\"paddle_ocr_config\":{\"language\":\"en\",\"model_tier\":\"mobile\",\"model_version\":\"pp-ocrv6\"}}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
